raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 (327 rows) has source_tz='UTC', while the other batches are America/Chicago local time. Its first rows are at 12:00 UTC, which is 06:00 Chicago, the same opening time the Chicago batches show. The silver step ignores source_tz, so these UTC rows are shifted +6h. That pushes the late-evening transactions into 00:00-06:00 on the next date, which is the 72 flagged rows. The fix is to convert UTC rows to Chicago local time in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
